assets.caption: FIGURE 17    EXAMPLES OF BURIAL DESIGN
assets.notes: Three sub-diagrams illustrating different pipeline burial design configurations. Top: basic mound burial. Middle: clay mound with paving stones, slope 1:2, steel wall, min 0.6 m depth, remove black earth layer. Bottom: pit design with rubber slab at vertical oval transit, maintain present ground, dimensions min 0.6 m, min 1.5 m, min 0.6 m.
